title: Workspace Roles Matrix + Audit Log: compact admin flows and cost-aware role controls
creator: Lena Kauffman
description: Goal: Define a compact, scalable RBAC surface for workspace/org admins that integrates audit logging and cost visibility without overwhelming operators. Scope includes: (1) Admin role matrix UI (roles, scoped permissions, grant paths), (2) Access Review flow (scheduled and ad-hoc), (3) Audit Log explorer with filters and export, (4) Cost visibility tied to role visibility (billing-only breakdowns), and (5) Prototypes for mobile/desktop and a lightweight onboarding flow for new orgs. Deliverables: high-fidelity Figma prototype, interaction spec, accessibility checklist, and handoff-ready tokenized components for ENG. Constraints: must work with existing Console nav, respect privacy/KMS constraints for Private deployments, and support 365-day audit retention for Enterprise customers.
prototypes: Figma interactive prototype — Workspace admin flow v3 (link above)

review_notes: 2025-02-18 PM sync: Prefer fewer predefined roles + ability to create custom roles; PM asked for default 'Billing Admin' and 'Security Admin' separation.
2025-02-25 ENG review: Suggested backend permission model limitations; recommended limiting per-resource granularity for MVP to workspace/org-level only.
2025-03-03 Security review: Audit exports must be signed and include immutable event IDs; retention default 365 days for Enterprise, configurable per contract.
Decision: Cost breakdown UI will be gated to billing admins. Rollout plan to start as a console feature flag for Dedicated customers and rollout to Hosted after telemetry shows no performance issues.
Design approval pending: Accessibility pass and copy edits; final sign-off requested 2025-03-10.

access_review_requirements: Owner nomination and two-step confirmation for role revocation
audit_log_features: Free-text search + filters (actor, action, resource, time range)
Immutable event IDs and signed export
Link-to-request context (prompt hash + model variant) where allowed
cost_integration_notes: Show cost breakdown only to Billing Admins; aggregated by route/model and time window
Include token-level cost trends on role pages to detect expensive workloads per team
Expose pointers to Optimize recommendations when a role's workloads exceed thresholds
accessibility_considerations: Contrast and focus states for small-cell matrices
Screen-reader labels for permission toggles and aggregated summaries
Avoid color-only cues for role severity
